name: skript-lsp
description: Language support for Skript (Minecraft scripting) via skript-lsp

skript-lsp.serverPath.description: Path to the skript-lsp binary. Leave empty to use the bundled binary, or set a custom path.

skript-lsp.logLevel.description: Log level for the LSP server (written to stderr).

skript-lsp.maxCompletions.description: Maximum number of completion items returned per request.

enumDescriptions: Show the (deliberately partial) AST parser's errors as red errors
Show them as dimmed hints (default — the corpus line-checker is the validity authority)
skript-lsp.parserDiagnostics.description: How AST parser errors are surfaced. The parser is partial by design; use 'error' only if you want maximum strictness.

scripts.compile: bun build --outdir out --target node --external vscode --format cjs --minify src/extension.ts
scripts.watch: bun --watch build --outdir out --target node --external vscode --format cjs src/extension.ts
scripts.dev:install: bun run build:binary && bun run compile && bun run package && bun run install-ext
scripts.prepublish: bun run build:binary && bun run compile
